summary: Complete independent audit of all 318 Chinese units, 55 temporal or active-hint checks, and 15 people. Numbered Jin reign-year offices, diplomatic missions, and dated court events are supported. 熙宗時 is an undated ruler-period phrase and cannot establish an activity interval spanning AD 1135–1149; the separately explicit 1142 attestation remains supported. No source or canonical extraction was edited.
